description: Set the Position property on a video clip's Motion effect using English or measured Spanish built-in names, then read it back. Values are in pixels.

x.description: X position in sequence pixels (converted to Premiere's normalized Position when the host stores it that way)

y.description: Y position in sequence pixels (converted to Premiere's normalized Position when the host stores it that way)

name: set_clip_position

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Set Clip Position
